name: registry.read
description: Read a registry key or single value. With `value` set, returns just that value's type and data; without, returns the whole key (values + subkeys). Read-only.

path.description: Registry path in `HKLM\Software\...` form (or `HKCU`, `HKCR`, `HKU`, `HKCC` roots). Hive abbreviations expanded server-side.

value.description: Optional value name. When supplied, returns just `{type, data}` for that single value. When omitted, returns the whole key — `{values: {...}, subkeys: [...]}`.

type.description: Win32 registry value type. Present only when `value` was supplied.

data.description: Value data as a string. REG_SZ/REG_EXPAND_SZ/REG_LINK: the literal string. REG_DWORD/REG_QWORD: decimal-stringified integer. REG_BINARY: base64. REG_MULTI_SZ: null-byte-separated, with a trailing null. Present only when `value` was supplied.

values.description: Map of value-name → {type, data} for all values under `path`. Present only when `value` was omitted (whole-key read).

subkeys.description: Names of subkeys under `path`. Present only when `value` was omitted (whole-key read).

x-implementations.name: reg_open_query
x-implementations.description: Win32 `RegOpenKeyExW` + `RegQueryValueExW` (for single-value mode) or `RegEnumValueW` + `RegEnumKeyExW` (for whole-key mode).

windows-modern.description: RegOpenKeyExW + RegQueryValueExW / RegEnumValueW. KEY_READ access. 64-bit views: HKLM\Software paths transparently redirect through WoW64 on 32-bit agent → 64-bit OS; agents that need explicit view selection can pass paths with `\Wow6432Node\` or rely on the agent's bitness matching the host.

windows-classic.description: Same Win32 APIs since NT 3.1. RegEnumValueW is NT 5+; classic NT 4 / 9x agents use RegEnumValueA with ANSI transcoding. Win 9x has a different (file-backed) registry implementation but the API surface matches.
